about.title: About BanuBazaar
about.intro: BanuBazaar is a marketplace built for Afghan women — a safe, simple place to buy and sell pre-loved items.
about.mission: We believe that things you no longer need can bring joy to someone else. A dress, a laptop, a set of dishes — every item has a story. BanuBazaar gives it a new chapter.
about.point1: Help women turn unused items into income
about.point2: Support Afghan women artists and creators
about.point3: Build a trusted community of buyers and sellers
about.disclaimer: BanuBazaar is a listing platform only. We connect buyers and sellers — but all transactions happen directly between them.
about.thanks: 🌸 Thank you for being part of our story.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.item1: 1. BanuBazaar is a listing platform only. We do not handle payments, deliveries, or transactions.
terms.item2: 2. All transactions happen directly between buyers and sellers. BanuBazaar is not responsible for any disputes, losses, or issues.
terms.item3: 3. Users must be honest about the items they list.
terms.item4c: Never share personal information, banking details, or your home/work address
terms.item5: 5. BanuBazaar reserves the right to remove any listing that violates our guidelines.
terms.thanks: By using BanuBazaar, you agree to these terms.
